notes.title: Buildings: concept arts
notes.content:
HELLO EXO, an addictive strategy game with a sci-fi motif, will feature multiple kinds of buildings.
 
Work on the buildings began with the creation of concept arts. One of the buildings available in HELLO EXO will be the Science Operations Center.

The Science Operations Center is a significant place. The tech tree will be located exactly here.

Extraction of Exoplanet's Resources

The extraction and processing of Exoplanet’s natural resources are required for the mission to succeed.

Natural resources will be extracted using Mining Plants.

notes.title: Well, HELLO EXO!
notes.content:
Hello! We are Weasel Games, an independent studio powered by passion.
The addictive sci-fi strategy game HELLO EXO is Weasel Games' debut release.

About HELLO EXO

There is no life on Earth in 2072 but humanity has managed to create aging-stopping hibernation pods. Recent research has revealed how to locate an Earth-like exoplanet. You were shipped there. Your mission is to repair the spaceship, keep people in hibernation pods alive, and prepare the exoplanet for their arrival.

You will build and manage the base, explore the exoplanet, transform it, and produce everything needed to turn the exo into a livable environment.

Check out the first glimpse if you missed our announcement trailer!

[previewyoutube=JTOCADoe8-0;full][/previewyoutube]
We were born to explore, constantly looking for new breakthroughs and pushing ourselves and the boundaries to create new and unique gameplay experiences.

You can support us!
